drops.title: Topo Ink
drops.brief: Warm paper-cream body with a high-contrast topographic contour-map field — nested closed ink contours from a continuous vehicle-space height field, charcoal major/minor contour lines plus occasional cadmium index contours wrapping every panel continuously; regenerated map impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Argyle Cut
drops.brief: Ivory body with a high-contrast argyle diamond lattice in crimson and navy that tiles continuously in vehicle space (u=nose→tail, v=roof→rocker) — intersecting 45° diamonds wrapping around every panel, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Terrazzo Pop
drops.brief: Warm parchment body densely speckled with multi-color terrazzo chips (coral, teal, mustard, indigo, charcoal) — irregular chips of varying size that feel continuous across door seams via shared (u,v) noise; high-contrast graphic stone, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Slash Field
drops.brief: Bone-cream body scored by bold vermillion and charcoal diagonal slash bands (~35° in vehicle space) that wrap continuously around every panel — high-contrast graphic cut fields, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Bayou Dusk
drops.brief: Deep bayou teal-black body with coral-orange Gulf sunset ribbons flowing continuous nose→tail across door seams, and cool silver downtown light-grid streams cascading from roof toward rockers — Space City night energy, high contrast for touchscreen; regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Volt Rail
drops.brief: Graphite-black body with electric lime and cyan continuous power-rail streams running nose→tail, hot-white edge sparks cascading from the roof downhill — high contrast for the touchscreen; regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: chi-lake
drops.brief: Chicago lakefront night: Michigan teal and midnight navy cascading from the roof, with amber L-train window sparks and soft skyline reflections drifting downhill — continuous UV remaster so sides flow fender→doors→quarter (Cybertruck unchanged). Regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: reef-flash
drops.brief: Abyssal navy with electric turquoise and hot-magenta reef-scale flashes cascading from the roof downhill toward hood, rockers, and tail — animal-as-texture, high contrast for the touchscreen.

drops.title: la-dusk
drops.brief: Los Angeles dusk impression: coral-magenta sun disk on the roof bleeding into indigo night toward the rockers, with soft palm-frond silhouettes and thin freeway light ribbons drifting downhill — regenerated, no logos.

drops.title: norther
drops.brief: Texas blue norther: ice-white rime on deep navy, heavier at the roof and blowing out toward hood, rockers, and tail.

drops.title: robotaxi
drops.brief: Glossy champagne-gold Cybercab paint with original ROBOTAXI lettering on the doors, hood, and tailgate for the September 3 2026 Austin launch.

drops.title: taxi-steam
drops.brief: Wet-asphalt night wrap with taxi-yellow lane stripes and steam veils rising from a subway-tile roof, skyline silhouettes as texture running downhill toward hood, rockers, and tailgate.

drops.title: ion-bloom
drops.brief: Ink-black bodywork blooming high-contrast ion-violet flowers from the roof, each petal edged in electric-cyan that cascades downhill toward hood, rockers, and tailgate.

drops.title: magma-rift
drops.brief: Charcoal basalt split by high-contrast molten-gold magma rifts that originate on the roof and flow downhill toward rockers, hood, and tailgate.

drops.title: ember-cascade
drops.brief: Ember cascade: warm fire-scale cascade (sister-line accidental drop).

drops.title: laser-vein
drops.brief: High-contrast laser-vein network in electric cyan and hot magenta originating at the roof center and flowing outward under gravity.

drops.title: neon-cascade
drops.brief: High-contrast neon cyan-to-magenta liquid cascades dripping from the vehicle crown (UV center), flowing downhill across every panel.

drops.title: neon-vortex
drops.brief: Deep-space black pierced by neon-cyan and magenta energy vortex centered on the roof, plasma trails cascading downhill.

drops.title: plasma-veil
drops.brief: Deep-space violet body with high-contrast cyan-to-magenta plasma ribbons that birth at the roof/hood high points and cascade outward under gravity toward hood, rockers and tail.

drops.title: plasma-vein
drops.brief: Deep void-black panels laced with electric-cyan and magenta plasma veins originating at the roof center and flowing downhill.

drops.title: robotaxi
drops.brief: Glossy champagne-gold Cybercab molded paint. No side lettering, matching production Cybercab.
